register.title: Mykhailo Polkovskyi's KKT refinements at 70a033f, no issue
register.headline: Tighter exact certificates at twelve counts from Mykhailo Polkovskyi, refining the standing packings, published with no issue
register.source_checks: The source's README, unchanged since 46f638c, states that every certificate passes Evan Daniel's exact checkers verify_cert.py and verify_cert2.py with zero tolerance and that every separating-axis margin and boundary clearance is strictly positive; census.json at the pin names the source of each count, 'Mykhailo Polkovskyi (ultra-precision KKT dual-verified optimum)' at the twelve counts registered here. The commit, 'Refine 14 contested certificates to ultra-precision KKT endpoints', states no further check. Those statements are the author's; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit Mykhailo Polkovskyi (https://github.com/Mishapolk/square-packing-records), the name the author asks for on issue 593, with each certificate as a refinement of the packing it tightens, after that packing's finder: Daniil Ostashev's at 129, 204 and 303 (T-162, issue 562), 175, 232 and 264 (T-158, issue 528) and 176 and 304 (issue 575; T-175 at 304), and Francisco Couzo's at 154 (T-182, issue 586), 156 and 271 (T-161, issue 561) and 302 (T-181, issues 583 and 586); at 129, 156, 175, 176, 204, 232, 264, 271 and 303 by way of PingYou Ltd's refinement (T-174, PR 574). Measured here, every certificate places every square centre within 1.1e-3 of the certificate it tightens, and within 1e-15 at 156, 175, 264, 271, 302, 303 and 304. The commit states no AI assistance; census.json credits ten other counts, which this entry does not register, to 'Antigravity', and issue 593 discloses Gemini assistance.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then decide adoption at the twelve counts: each certificate is below its case's ceiling and below every earlier report at its count, the nearest by 1.25e-94 (176) to 1.79e-19 (302 and 304). Final exact-head CI remains required.
